summary: Tested the handoff round: backend and frontend, desktop at 1920 and mobile at 390. All 12 requested items PASS. Backend: test_handoff_rules, test_assemble_flow and test_fixtures_demo_content pass 28/28 (-n 0). A new test_iter6_guards.py passes 3/3: a Redwood-only draft fails and POST /links returns 409 with links_count 0; a partner gets 403 on GET /api/project; a historic Cedar change request returns 409 from POST /preview after Cedar's sites move to Redwood (v3 passes at $163,200), and Close still works. Frontend results per item. (1) Login: the promise text, the big Try the example button and its subtitle are correct. Partner logins stay hidden until the toggle is clicked. Practice logins are not shown on Create account. (2) The tour does not open by itself; demo-tour-open opens it. (3) Redirects: dogwood at /login?next=/project lands on /reviews. /project and /summary show the header, the message and route-denied-reviews-button, which goes to /reviews. Organizer at next=/reviews lands on /project. (4) Alder+Redwood and Redwood alone: draft-repair-notice shows, there is no Go to partners button, Next step stays on Prepare a draft, ask-blocked-notice shows and every create-link button is disabled. (5) Baseline $168,000 passes. After confirmations through partner-card-demo-review-*, the summary strip reads 'Yes / Yes · $168,000 of $180,000 / 3 of 3 partners / 2 conditions'. Ask each partner is done without marking links shared, and mark-shared is replaced by 'They have opened and answered this link.' (6) Job conditions: the unsaved badge and gap-stale-notice show; after save the condition appears in gap-conditions-list and in decide-open-conditions as 'Job: ...'; marking it resolved removes it. The Next banner mentions open conditions when everyone has confirmed. (7) Reading the customer brief (LLM, ~60s): the 'Job condition / Job' reading can be selected and applied, and then shows in job conditions and the gap panel. The action bar is position:sticky. Deadlines are grouped (reading-group-site-deadline-week) and there are 19 fact-evidence disclosures. The sample PDF button shows 'Preparing sample PDF…' with Read disabled. (8) Amendment: the lead reads '2 sites change · +$0 · 1 partner needs review' and Select is disabled because the preview fails. Reassigning S09/S10 to Dogwood shows the unsaved badge and blocks Select until saved. After saving, $172,000 passes. The dialog shows v2, $172,000, (+$4,000 vs v1) and 'Must review again: Alder, Dogwood'. Birch and Cedar stay confirmed with 'orig time · carried to v2 time'. (9) After reassigning, -100000 on Alder gives 'largest discount allowed is $28,000' and the input keeps the value. Before reassigning it says $56,000, which is right for 4 sites. +100000 on Dogwood fails at $272,000. (10) The historic change request shows change-request-inapplicable-* with Close and no Open as preview. (11) Tour: Next/Back switch the intake tab between read and form. Do it for me on the select step goes to Decide, leaves the preview unselected and shows a toast. Running the customer-change step again creates no duplicate, both while the preview is open and after it was applied. (12) At 390px, login, the partner list, the project sheet, Decide and the amendment panel (with errors) have scrollWidth equal to 390. No page errors seen.

minor.issue: Error text uses raw partner names, e.g. 'Price adjustment for Alder Line Electric (Synthetic)…'. The UI strips ' (Synthetic)' everywhere else, so the name shows inconsistently in amend-errors.

The guard calls L.check(version) without job_conditions, but sheet() calls L.check({...v, job_conditions}). This only matters if job conditions ever affect pass/fail; currently they don't. Consider one shared helper.

issues: Step titles are hidden below sm, so the stepper shows only icons and numbers. Consider short labels or an aria-label/title for each step.
'Document date' uses the browser's native date input (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of the shadcn Calendar/Popover used elsewhere.
Opening the tour from another task (e.g. Draft) shows step 1 'Check this job' but stays on the current task until Show me or Next is clicked.
At 1920px the fixed tour card covers the 'Answered' column of the Decide table. It can be minimised, so this is low priority.

action_items: Optional: strip ' (Synthetic)' from partner names in backend validation and error messages, or display-clean them in ErrorList
Optional: show step labels in the mobile stepper
Optional: replace the native date input in ReadDocumentForm with the shadcn date picker
Optional: when the tour opens, move to the stored step's task
critical_code_review_comments: project_routes.py select_preview/create_link: check() runs without job_conditions, unlike sheet(). Use one helper so the guard and the UI always agree.

ChangeRequests.jsx decides a request is historic from sheet.current.partners, while the server uses L.partner_owners(cur). These match today; keep them in sync if partner_statuses ever lists partners with no sites.
DemoTour customer_change reuses any open customer CR (status open, no partner_id), even one logged against an older version. This is acceptable for the demo.
seed_data_creation: Sandboxes for visitor_ids test-ui6amend0000001, test-ui6histor000001 (historic Cedar change request; v3 plan with Redwood) and test-ui6mobile000001 were created with tests/seed_baseline_ui.py. No shared or seeded data was changed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use tests/seed_baseline_ui.py <visitor_id> [historic] to put a sandbox into the baseline-confirmed state. Then in Playwright set localStorage 'assemble_visitor' to that id, reload, wait about 2s and click signin-demo-organizer-button. Clicking immediately once hit a transient case where the page stayed on /login. Each browser_automation run otherwise gets a fresh visitor or sandbox. Run the regression suite with -n 0. The order matters for the -100000 discount check: reassign S09/S10 to Dogwood first, then the limit is $28,000; before that Alder has 4 sites and the limit is $56,000.
test_credentials: From /app/memory/test_credentials.md: demo accounts *@demo.assemble.test, password synthetic-demo, visitor_id required.
